tip.title.description: Title of the user's page of the tips, one-time payments to the server's operation with nothing in return. Never word a tip as a donation.

tip.app.defaultMessage: 這個頁面無法在應用程式中使用。
tip.app.description: Shown in the mobile app instead of the page of the tips.

tip.disabled.defaultMessage: 這個伺服器不接受小費。
tip.disabled.description: Shown on the page of the tips when the server takes none.

tip.loading.description: Label of the spinner while the page of the tips loads.

tip.failed.description: Heading of the error when the page of the tips could not load.

tip.retry.description: Button that loads the page of the tips again after an error.

tip.return.confirming.defaultMessage: 正在向支付服務商確認你的付款，需要幾秒鐘。
tip.return.confirming.description: Shown back from the payment provider's page while the server confirms the payment of the tip.

tip.return.canceled.defaultMessage: 你已離開付款頁面，沒有扣款。
tip.return.canceled.description: Shown back from the payment provider's page when the user left it or it ended unpaid.

tip.return.unconfirmed.defaultMessage: 支付服務商尚未確認付款。如果你已付款，確認後就會記錄下來，你不需要再付一次。
tip.return.unconfirmed.description: Shown back from the payment provider's page when the payment of the tip is still not confirmed after the page asked many times.

tip.thanks.status.description: Announced when the tip that the user returned from paying is paid.

tip.thanks.title.description: Heading of the thanks after a tip is paid.

tip.thanks.description.defaultMessage: 你的 {amount} 小費將用於 {server} 的營運。
tip.thanks.description.description: Under the thanks after a tip is paid. amount is a formatted amount, such as ¥500; server is the name of the server. Say nothing of a donation or a deduction.

tip.form.title.description: Heading of the form of a tip. server is the name of the server.

tip.form.description.defaultMessage: 小費是付給本站營運者、用於伺服器營運的一次性款項，不附帶任何回報：沒有徽章、角色或其他福利。
tip.form.description.description: What a tip is, above the choice of its amount. Never word it as a donation, and never suggest a deduction.

tip.form.amount.description: Label of the choice of the amount of a tip, among the operators' amounts.

tip.form.submit.description: Button that opens the final confirmation of a tip.

tip.ineligible.not_local.defaultMessage: 只有本站的使用者可以給小費。
tip.ineligible.not_local.description: Why the user cannot tip: the account is not of this server.

tip.ineligible.email_unverified.defaultMessage: 要給小費，請先點擊伺服器寄給你的電子郵件中的連結，驗證你的電子郵件地址。
tip.ineligible.email_unverified.description: Why the user cannot tip, and how to become able to: their primary email address is not verified.

tip.ineligible.restricted.defaultMessage: 你的帳號在停權或刪除期間無法給小費。
tip.ineligible.restricted.description: Why the user cannot tip: the account is suspended or being deleted.

tip.confirm.title.defaultMessage: 要為 {server} 的營運給 {amount} 小費嗎？
tip.confirm.title.description: Title of the final confirmation before the payment provider's page. amount is a formatted amount, such as ¥500; server is the name of the server.

tip.confirm.description.defaultMessage: 請確認下方的條件。你的付款資料是在支付服務商的頁面輸入，而不是在本站。
tip.confirm.description.description: Under the title of the final confirmation of a tip.

tip.confirm.amount.description: Term of the final confirmation of a tip: its amount.

tip.confirm.payment.description: Term of the final confirmation of a tip: when it is paid.

tip.confirm.payment.value.defaultMessage: 一次性，立即付款，不會自動續期。
tip.confirm.payment.value.description: When a tip is paid: once, at once, never again.

tip.confirm.return.description: Term of the final confirmation of a tip: what the user gets for it.

tip.confirm.return.value.defaultMessage: 沒有。小費不附帶福利、角色或徽章。

tip.confirm.go.description: Button of the final confirmation of a tip that opens the payment provider's page.

tip.confirm.cancel.description: Button that closes the final confirmation of a tip.

tip.confirm.failed.description: Error in the final confirmation of a tip. reason is why, localized.

tip.commerce.description: Link in the final confirmation of a tip to the server's commerce disclosures.

tip.error.rate_limited.defaultMessage: 發起的小費次數過多，請稍後再試。
tip.error.rate_limited.description: Problem: the server limits how many tips are started.

tip.error.rate_limited_until.defaultMessage: 發起的小費次數過多，請在 {time} 之後再試。
tip.error.rate_limited_until.description: Problem: the server limits how many tips are started. time is a formatted time, such as 3:15 PM.

tip.error.disabled.defaultMessage: 這個伺服器已不再接受小費。
tip.error.disabled.description: Problem: the server stopped taking tips.

tip.error.amount.defaultMessage: 這個金額已不再提供，請重新載入頁面後再選擇。
tip.error.amount.description: Problem: the amount is not one of the operators' amounts any more.

tip.error.pending.defaultMessage: 你的另一筆小費正在發起中，請稍等一下再試。
tip.error.pending.description: Problem: another start of the user's tip runs at the same time.

tip.error.closing.defaultMessage: 服務即將結束，因此不再接受小費。
tip.error.closing.description: Problem: the closure of the service was announced.

tip.entry.go.description: Link to the page of the tips, on the about page, the funding meter's panel and the page of the supporter plans.

tip.entry.sign_in.description: Link for a visitor who is not signed in to sign in and then reach the page of the tips.

tip.entry.eligibility.defaultMessage: 本站已驗證電子郵件地址的使用者可以給小費。
tip.entry.eligibility.description: Who may tip, on the about page for a visitor who is not signed in.

tip.about.title.description: Heading of the section of the tips on the about page and the page of the supporter plans.

tip.about.description.defaultMessage: 你可以為 {server} 的營運給一次性的小費，不附帶任何回報。
tip.about.description.description: What a tip is, on the about page. server is the name of the server. Never word it as a donation.

tip.settings.description.defaultMessage: 除了方案之外，你也可以為本站的營運給一次性的小費，不附帶任何回報。
tip.settings.description.description: The tips on the page of the supporter plans.
